fields.statement: The inbox raises no accept item for a gated change set whose run journaled its own accept, rather than labelling the item 'accepted on branch, PR #N merging': the run already carries the change set to merge, so the owner has nothing to do, and a label would keep a non-actionable item and need a PR lookup the inbox does not do
fields.wording: planner's pick of the two remedies the bug request offers; autonomous plan-bug run, no owner present

fields.acceptance: A new test in internal/api/inbox_run_accepted_test.go feeds inboxItems a plan-run journal with a gated entry for two change sets and an accepted entry for one of them, with changeState reporting both proposed: exactly one InboxAccept item is listed, for the change set the run did not accept; with no accepted entry both are listed. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -run 'TestInbox' and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(inbox-owner-run-accept|stage-autonomy)' pass. Touches internal/api/inbox.go, internal/api/inbox_run_accepted_test.go
fields.statement: rhiza inbox raises no accept item for a change set a plan run gated when that same run journaled an accepted entry for it (st.Accepts, Verb accepted, Change the gated ID), even while main's model still says proposed; a gated change set the run did not accept (rhiza.autonomy.accept owner, or the review did not pass) keeps its 'waiting for acceptance' item with next rhiza accept --rule owner --change <id>
